override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Structure: the kit splits SUMMON (skill1 start-of-battle ×4, burst ×6) from the SUMMON-TRIGGERED damage (skill2 'Activates when Near Feather is summoned' → 90.81% true). The engine has no summon primitive, so the Near Feather Attack is authored at each summon site: 4 instances on the skill1 passive block, 6 instances on the burst block. skill2 therefore holds only the Full-Charge buff; its damage line is IMPLEMENTED, not dropped. Read literally, the attack fires ONCE PER SUMMON — if feathers persist and attack repeatedly, this model UNDERSTATES her (⚑ feather-persistence). Feather attacks are authored as N separate flatDamage instances (split) rather than one merged hit — kit-silent, popup-read decides (⚑). Burst blocks are ordered buffs-first so the burst's own True Damage ▲55.3% is live for the 6 feather hits and the 300.02% hit; if the real cast snapshots pre-buff, drop the buff block below the damage blocks (⚑). Full-Charge trigger mapped to shotFired: every SR trigger pull on this unit is a full-charge shot (chargeFrames 60), so shotFired ≡ 'attacking with Full Charge'; the 'for 1 shot(s)' window is durationShots:1 (⚑ whether the triggering shot itself benefits or only the next one). noFb left default-ON-by-timing (unmeasured); noRange not set (engine-automatic).
caveats: ⚑ Near Feather persistence: kit text gives the attack a summon trigger only. If in-game feathers orbit and strike repeatedly, every feather hit here is understated by the repeat count.
⚑ Split-vs-merge: 4/6 feather attacks authored as separate flatDamage instances; a merged single hit would change popup count and crit variance (expected total unchanged).
⚑ passive+flatDamage semantics: the skill1 block assumes the engine fires a passive-triggered flatDamage exactly once at battle start.
⚑ Full-Charge trigger: shotFired stands in for 'attacking with Full Charge'; durationShots:1 self-apply ordering (this shot vs next shot) is unverified.
⚑ Burst self-buff ordering: assumes the burst's True Damage ▲55.3% is live for the burst's own true-damage hits.
⚑ Cadence tuple (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6) is datamine-sourced and unreliable; it gates both shot count and the 80%-per-shot charge buff uptime.

flags.estimate: ONE 90.81% hit per feather summoned (4 at battle start, 6 per burst = 10 hits/fight before extra bursts)
flags.reasoning: The kit gives the attack the trigger 'when Near Feather is summoned' and nothing else — no duration, no attack cadence, no despawn rule. Read literally that is one hit per summon. But a 'summon' that deals its damage once and then has no further stated existence is mechanically odd; if the feathers persist as orbiting drones and strike on a timer, the true damage is (repeat count)x this model. This is the single largest magnitude risk in the override.
flags.recipe: Record a solo Ein fight; count true-damage popups in the first ~5s (expect exactly 4 if summon-only) and in the 10s after a burst (expect exactly 6 + 1x300%). If popups exceed the summon count, re-author as a per-feather interval/dot with a measured cadence and feather lifetime.

flags.estimate: A passive-triggered flatDamage fires exactly once, at battle start (frame 0)
flags.reasoning: 'Activates at the start of battle' has no schema trigger of its own; passive is the closest ('always active'). If the engine instead re-evaluates passive flatDamage per frame/per shot, this block would multiply catastrophically; if it never fires it, the 4 opening feathers vanish.
flags.recipe: Harness test: runComp(controlComp('ein')) with cfg.onEvent, filter damage events with mult ~= 90.81 in the first second; assert count === 4 and that no further 90.81% events occur before the first burst.

flags.estimate: SPLIT: N separate flatDamage instances (4 and 6), not one merged 363.24% / 544.86% hit
flags.reasoning: Kit-silent multi-projectile encoding is an ALWAYS-⛑ field. Split vs merge is total-damage-neutral in expectation but changes popup count and per-hit crit variance, and merge would be wrong if a future core/crit rider is attached per feather.
flags.recipe: Read the popup stream on a recording: 4 discrete white/true popups at t~0 => split; one large popup => merge. Same check on the 6-feather burst volley.

flags.estimate: trigger shotFired, durationShots:1, and the TRIGGERING shot itself benefits (schema: decremented after the shot's blocks dispatch)
flags.reasoning: There is no fullCharge trigger in the schema; for an SR with chargeFrames 60 every pull is a full charge, so shotFired is exact in effect — UNLESS the engine emits shotFired for uncharged/interrupted pulls, in which case uptime is over-credited. Separately, 'for 1 shot(s)' could mean the NEXT shot only, which would zero the buff on the opening shot and on the first shot after each reload if apply-order differs.
flags.recipe: onEvent: pair each shot damage event's charge-bucket mult against the buffApply for chargeDamagePct=80; assert the buff is live on the same shot that applied it, and that shot count with the buff === total shots fired.

flags.field: override.burst block ordering (self-buff block before damage blocks)
flags.estimate: The burst's own True Damage ▲55.3% IS live for its 6 feather hits and the 300.02% hit
flags.reasoning: The kit lists the buffs and the damage in the same burst, buffs first, and both damage lines are true-flavored — so the buff plausibly self-applies. But burst damage that snapshots pre-cast (the burstSnapshotsPreFb pattern) would exclude it, a ~55% Damage-Up swing on ~845% of burst damage.
flags.recipe: Compare the burst-window true-damage popup values against a control run with the trueDamagePct buff removed; the ratio tells you directly whether the real game applies it to its own hits.

flags.estimate: 1.0s charge + ~2.35s reload every 6 shots => ~0.7 shots/s sustained
flags.reasoning: Datamined cadence fields are the known-unreliable channel (60fps frame-boundary rounding, kit-silent charge-cancel behaviour). Every charge-bucket number in this override (80% per-shot + 140.68% burst) scales linearly with shots fired, so a cadence error propagates straight into total damage.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter read on a recording (shots/sec measured directly, not inferred from burst-gauge or FB counts) over one full magazine + reload cycle.
